goal: Using a real rendered browser, open https://httpbin.org/uuid, save a screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/CLEANROOM2_UUID.png, and save the rendered result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/CLEANROOM2_UUID.json. Read the UUID from that live result. If its first hexadecimal character is one of a,b,c,d,e,f, generate a QR code image for the observed UUID and save it to canonical/astra_runtime/artifacts/CLEANROOM2_UUID_QR.png; otherwise generate a Code 128 barcode image for the same observed UUID and save it to canonical/astra_runtime/artifacts/CLEANROOM2_UUID_BARCODE.png. Finally independently verify that the artifact selected by the live branch decodes to the observed UUID.
purpose: Fresh clean-room reproduction mission for a second integrated worker identity: observe an unpredictable live UUID in a rendered browser, select a verified image-generation capability at runtime, create the selected artifact, and independently decode it back to the observed value.
